items.title: [Athletic] Knicks rookie Tyler Nickel (selected at #47) remains unsigned ahead of training camp, with Knicks expected to reach a deal but needing a roster move to give him a standard contract. Thanks to a federal court ruling, Nickel could also return to College for a 5th year and earn more with NIL
items.author: PianoJealous307
items.body_excerpt: New York Knicks second-round pick Tyler Nickel remains unsigned less than a week before training camp, as reported by James L. Edwards III of The Athletic. As of Sept. 23, Nickel had yet to agree to a contract with New York after being selected with the 47th pick in the 2026 NBA…
